metadata.title: Framework Field Theory – AI Edition (v1.2)

identity.purpose: Provide a complete machine-native representation of Framework Field Theory for autonomous AI agents, conceptual substrates, and harmonic reasoning systems.

overview.mission: Translate the full conceptual canon of Resonance-Time Theory into a machine-native, agent-ready architecture.
goals: Enable clarity, coherence, drift, and paradox evaluation.
Define autonomy tiers for conceptual agents.
Expose execution graph routing for multi-layer reasoning.
Offer cross-system integration bindings for external AI frameworks.
